riders_at_gate.title: The Riders at the Gate
riders_at_gate.intro: Eight riders in grey cloaks have reined in before the gate. Their captain wants the toll in full, and the house has already said no.

victory.chronicle: {When}, the house beat back the Tollmaster's riders at the gate. They rode off with their captain's pride and nothing else.

defeat.chronicle: {When}, the riders broke into the yard and took what they wanted from the store before they rode away.

withdraw.chronicle: {When}, the brothers drew back inside the gate and barred it, and the riders shouted at the wall until they tired.

ambush_on_road.title: An Ambush on the Road
ambush_on_road.intro: At {node}, men with cudgels stepped out of the hedge across the road. They want the cart, and the brothers have only their staves.

victory.chronicle: {When}, the party beat off the road men at {node}, and kept the road as far as home.

defeat.chronicle: {When}, road men took the party's bread at {node} and left a brother bleeding in the ditch.

withdraw.chronicle: {When}, the party backed off from the hedge at {node} and went round by the bog road.

machines_in_the_field.title: The Machines in the Turbine Field
machines_in_the_field.intro: The grey machines of the turbine field have begun to turn. They make no sound. They come on steadily, and the brothers' staves are small against them.

victory.chronicle: {When}, the brothers broke the machines in the turbine field one by one, and carried home the least broken of their parts. Nothing came out of the field after that.

defeat.chronicle: {When}, the machines drove the brothers back from the turbine field, and one of them did not come home.

withdraw.chronicle: {When}, the brothers came back from the turbine field with their staves broken, and the machines stayed where they were.
